name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight shifted onto one leg, shoulders loose and ready, a confident, determined gaze toward the camera — a battle-ready stance, a fierce grin breaking across his face, eager for the fight.
effects: Heat haze shimmers faintly in the air around him.

components.wearing: fitted Ember Red-toned banded leather armor across the chest and shoulders, Burnished Bronze stitching and buckles, arms left bare for freedom of movement, a reinforced belt and leg wraps; scorch-marked leather plates, an ember-glow sigil branded over the heart
components.companion: his bonded Fire Elemental, a towering figure of living flame and molten rock, embers drifting from its form beside him

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the striker-group default wardrobe set + the existing rising-flames background (fits Fire thematically).
